accom_shared_hostel_dorm.evidenceText: On average, hostels in Nairobi cost around $9 per dorm bed per night. Hostelz.com compares prices for 10 hostels in Nairobi, Kenya.
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.referencePeriod: Hostelz Nairobi city comparison; result crawled 2 months before 2026-07-31; source period otherwise not stated
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.searchQuery: site:hostelz.com Nairobi Kenya hostel dorm private room average price
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.reason: Accepted as an exact Nairobi city-level central dorm-bed statistic in USD with one-adult bed basis and a stated 10-hostel comparison. This is a one-adult source input, not a two-traveller product value.
